briefings.title: The Rapid Rise Of The Two Billion Dollar Collegiate NIL Marketplace
briefings.tldr: The collegiate Name, Image, and Likeness (NIL) market has rapidly grown from zero to $2 billion in five years, projected to reach $6 billion by decade's end, with Opendorse CEO Steve Denton highlighting its maturation through regulation and the surprising trend of female student-athletes out-earning males in brand deals.
